title: Anime.js
description: Lightweight animation engine with SVG support.

data.text: Anime.js is a lightweight JavaScript animation library with a simple API and SVG support.

data.title: Anime.js

data.text: A Lightweight Engine for CSS and SVG

anime.js animates CSS properties, SVG attributes, and plain JavaScript objects with a compact API. `anime()` takes targets and properties, returns an animation you can play or pause, and a `stagger` option offsets each target so a group animates in sequence.

data.title: A staggered stagger

data.text: Because it can animate SVG attributes such as `strokeDashoffset`, anime.js is a common choice for line-drawing effects and icon transitions. Animating an object's numeric property and reading it back is how you drive a canvas or a custom render loop without touching the DOM at all.

data.title: Drawing an SVG path and driving a value
Where anime.js fits
data.text: It is smaller than a full timeline library and has a gentler API, which suits one-off reveals and SVG effects. For long, choreographed sequences with scroll control, GSAP timelin es are more capable. Choosing based on the complexity of the sequence, not on popularity, is the mark of a considered decision.
